questions.q_en:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(11, 16.5, 22)

(14.5, 20, 25.5)

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution_en:
11 + 5.5 = 16.5 + 5.5 = 22

14.5 + 5.5 = 20 + 5.5 = 25.5

Option (a): 14 + 5.5 = 19.5 + 5.5 = 25. So, option (a) is incorrect.

Option (b): 21.5 + 5.5 = 27 + 5.5 = 32.5. So, option (b) is incorrect.

Option (c): 18 + 5.5 = 23.5 + 5.5 = 29. So, option (c) is correct.

Option (d): 24.5 + 5.5 = 30 + 5.5 = 35.5. So, option (d) is incorrect.

Thus, the answer is option (c).

Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

[121, 93, 214]

[115, 87, 202]

[NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.]
questions.solution_en:
The relationship between the numbers is:

214 = 121 + 93

This indicates that the third number is the sum of the first two numbers in the set.

For each option:

1) 135+117=252≠259 (Incorrect)

2) 110+94=204≠224 (Incorrect)

3) 84+99=183≠189 (Incorrect)

4) 97+112=209 (Correct)

Thus, the correct set is (97, 112, 209).
